name: Finset
sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq
result.signature:
[CommSemiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [ExistsAddOfLE R] (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → R) :
  (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * ∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
  [ExistsAddOfLE R] (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → R), (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * ∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2
result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Finite Sums in Ordered Commutative Semirings
result.informal_description: In any linearly ordered commutative semiring $ R $ equipped with an additive structure compatible with its order and satisfying the strict ordered ring properties, for any finite set $ s $ and functions $ f, g : \iota \to R $, the square of the sum of the products $ f(i)g(i) $ over $ s $ is less than or equal to the product of the sums of the squares of $ f(i) $ and $ g(i) $ over $ s $. Formally, $$ \left( \sum_{i \in s} f(i)g(i) \right)^2 \leq \left( \sum_{i \in s} f(i)^2 \right) \left( \sum_{i \in s} g(i)^2 \right). $$

result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Sums in Ordered Commutative Semirings
result.informal_description: For a finite set $s$ and non-negative functions $f,g$ over $s$ in an ordered commutative semiring $R$, if $r_i^2 = f_i g_i$ for all $i \in s$, then $\left(\sum_{i \in s} r_i\right)^2 \leq \left(\sum_{i \in s} f_i\right) \cdot \left(\sum_{i \in s} g_i\right)$.

name: Real
sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
result.signature: (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i ≤ √(∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * √(∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2)
result.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ), ∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i ≤ √(∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * √(∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2)
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of indices $ \iota $ and functions $ f, g : \iota \to \mathbb{R} $, the inequality $ \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \cdot g(i) \leq \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} [f(i)]^2} \cdot \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} [g(i)]^2} $ holds.

name: NNReal
sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
result.signature: (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ≥0) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i ≤ sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2)
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → NNReal),
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i ≤ NNReal.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * NNReal.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2)
result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Non-negative Real Numbers
result.informal_description: For any finite set $s$ of indices $\iota$ and functions $f, g : \iota \to \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}$, the inequality $\sum_{i \in s} f(i)g(i) \leq \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} f(i)^2} \cdot \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} g(i)^2}$ holds, where the square roots denote the principal non-negative square roots defined on $\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}$.

name: Real
sum_sqrt_mul_sqrt_le
result.signature: (s : Finset ι) (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ g i) : ∑ i ∈ s, √(f i) * √(g i) ≤ √(∑ i ∈ s, f i) * √(∑ i ∈ s, g i)
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_2} {f g : ι → ℝ} (s : Finset ι),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ f i) → (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ g i) → ∑ i ∈ s, √(f i) * √(g i) ≤ √(∑ i ∈ s, f i) * √(∑ i ∈ s, g i)
result.value: := by simpa [*] using sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt _ (fun x ↦ √(f x)) (fun x ↦ √(g x))
result.informal_name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality for Sums of Square Roots of Non-Negative Functions
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ and non-negative real-valued functions $ f $ and $ g $ defined on $ s $, the inequality $ \sum_{i \in s} \sqrt{f(i)} \cdot \sqrt{g(i)} \leq \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} f(i)} \cdot \sqrt{\sum_{i \in s} g(i)} $ holds.
